notes.title: Patch 1.4.3.5
notes.notes:
- Fix problem where environment sometime obscure low camera
- Adding tanks moving in main menu background with stats showing their stats
- Improve map flow
- Lock arcade tank to much later stage as its control style is not enjoyable
- Small improvement in UI visual

notes.title: Patch 1.4.2.9 Improve co-op gameplay
notes.notes:
- In split screen co-op, each player can open the upgrade menu on their own screen without effecting others
- Add heal points to before boss arenas
- A better and smarter way of assigning game pad and keyboard/mouse to each player in Local co-op mode
- Reduce enemy Hp multiplier in Co-op mode ( now at 1.5 x for 3 players, 2x for 4 players )
- Remove player's Hp reduction in Co-op mode
- Fix bugs where enemies destruction effect sometime doesn't play in co-op mode
- Remove enemy spawn points that are too close to player check points

notes.title: Patch 1.4.2.2 notes
notes.notes:
Fix flag colour
 Fix got upgrade menu displayed on other player
 slightly tweaking default camera to give more forward view
 Fix focus problem in PVP lobby menu
 Fix problem where battle ship is spawned on land when loading some old version save game.
 Remove flag from leaderboard entries in Xbox
 Remove campaign stats from PVP pause menu
 Remove player box restriction in non shared screen games
 Fix xbox survival speed run leaderboard
 Fix leaderboard duplicate entries
 Fix PVP host crash when client joint
 Fix survival mode driver names

notes.title: Patch 1.4.1.3
notes.notes:
Upgrade system of co-op players are now totally independent of each other.
Drivers now have correct colors in multiplayers
Fix flame weapon of clients not activated visually on host
Fix collision to prevent player driver to go to tank attack battle ship area

notes.title: Patch 1.4.1.0
notes.notes:
Fix problem where left trigger button doesn't trigger dash
Fix battle cruiser audio and fire continue after disembarkment
Fix pvp collision
Slightly make the jeep boss easier
Fix some shoot collision in battle cruiser area

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1.0 ( Better aerial bomber target )
notes.notes:
Smarter aerial bomber drops
Add a button to invite player to see original Tank Brawl product on Steam
Tweak main menu appearance

notes.title: Patch notes 1.3.0.9
notes.notes:
Turretless tank now have a driver visual attached on top of it
When acquire the first tank, it doesn't drop drown glitch.
Prevent Elizabeth respawn after rescued
Translate the speed run record text

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0.7 Add speed run leaderboard
notes.notes:
Add campaign speed run leaderboard ( if you already started your campaign, the time will be estimated and is generally overestimate, if you aim for best spot in leaderboard, we advise to restart the campaign using options/reset campaign)

Add leaderboards to main menu

notes.title: Patch notes 1.3.0.5
notes.notes:
Mini Map added
 Local co-op one player can play with keyboard/mouse other can play with controller now supported
 Reduce global audio volume.
 On PC only - Add the ability for p1 uses keyboard and p2 use controller.
 Fix problem where the game becomes non responsive if controller is disconnected and reconnected during Pause menu open.
 Add backup turret pickup item to make sure players never miss it.
 Rearrange enemy for better gameplay flow
 Change player Mech colour to red
 Move heart counts and minimap to bottom left to minimizing obscure gameplay
 Fix driver names
 Refine bridges collision in last level
 Fix bug where the last boss can be exploited to kill quickly using Ram weapon
 Better Tutorial hint for crush tank to get turret
 Better tutorial guide in level 1
 Remove the confusing switch on Train Cross part of the game.
 Fix bug where non host doesn't see blocks during train chase level
 Fix bug where train crush damage doesn't kill driver in multiplayer
 Fix bug where chase train sometime disappear in multiplayer
 Fix bug where in 4 players games, going in arenas usually left 1 person out
 Better boat gun play

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0.4
notes.notes: Fix Crashes when closing upgrade menu and other places.

Swap to Stalin when rescue him
Add flag to friendly tanks
Add remove upgrade hint when trying to upgrade with no available gear
Prompt to ride on train appear after sometime to guide player
Reduce enemy HQ barrack from 5000 to 4000
Slight adjustment of default camera positioning
Add hint to adjust custom camera to custom camera name
Fix problem where crate only spawn item the first time
Add "Change Vehicle" prompt to first few check point to point it out more clearly
When player die on foot in level 1 by jeep, a guide to pick up tank turret will appear
Increase Stalin's knife weapon range
Fix possible exploit to get pass footbridge in level 1 without tank turret
Fix tank sometimes missing cannon part
Vehicle engine audio now play much better
Fix collision near water checkpoint in Level 2
Add more path blocker
Tweak first level enemy jeep gun fx
Let player swap between driver and tank at the checkpoint before acquiring turret
Fix bug where node hammer splash is not removed if hammer upgrade is removed
